objective: Reduce JS/React Native scheduling overhead during quick Home/Cluster/Wall/Connect/Profile switching while keeping the current AdMob viewport, UMP consent, request cooldown, real impressions and video playback semantics unchanged. Diagnostic evidence is based only on latest Android 1.3.6 build 30 runtime 1.3.2 last 15/30/60 minutes, never a 24h aggregate across releases.
productionBaselineEvidence: Nov 12 2026 PH 16:32 read-only production AdMob operational events last rolling 60m for Android 1.3.6 build 30 runtime 1.3.2: banner 26 requests/12 loads/2 impressions/14 no-fill, native 28 requests/5 loads/4 impressions, interstitial 3 requests/3 loads; no Google publisher-console match-rate evidence. Existing RC integration branch e01a35e remains draft and is NOT production. BSOC health events last 60m contain no Android rows, not proof of zero lag.
chosenApproach: Replace one independent 1.2-second poll interval and AppState listener per eligible advertising viewport with a module-shared interval and listener, retaining per-slot ref, 400ms double-measurement, generation/cleanup, foreground gate and delayed reservation.
selectionRationale: Each currently mounted sponsor uses the same hook and independently installs a timer/listener until eligible, multiplying callbacks during rapid dashboard transitions. A shared clock reduces overhead without increasing ad requests, changing SDK or touching existing video/native media screens.
alternativeApproaches: Request more ads by bypassing viewport: rejected due no-fill spam and offscreen impressions policy
Raise ad density or refresh aggressively: rejected because 15-minute current-build telemetry demonstrates banner no-fill, not a missing placement count
Rewrite dashboard routing: rejected without route-latency traces and risks breaking scope, chat and video
preserveBehaviors: Minimum 8px pending slot geometry and reservation-before-mount
Native ads UMP consent, AdMob live IDs, existing policy cooldown, no-fill quiet recovery
Video playback code, MediaView, cached content, navigation routes and membership scope handling unchanged
No app-side fake revenue or impressions and no database writes

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Single native AdMob viewport scheduler for all mounted slots replaces multiplicative per-slot timers during navigation. The touched generic file matches app-runtime governance; ads-finance-points / navigation-auth source paths are unchanged.
preservedBehaviors: Existing navigation, safe-area, auth/scope and media modules are byte-unchanged.
Ad rendering and request callbacks still own individual slots.

acceptanceChecks: TypeScript and CI focused regression test pass on exact head.
Video, native sponsored cards, banners, 400ms viewport settle and cooldown protected.
Before/after device frame timing on matching build/runtime still required to quantify actual dashboard improvement; owner manual validation may be skipped but never marked PASSED.
Compare only post-update 15/30/60m Android event buckets with exact app/build/runtime, never older release aggregates.
No OTA or production claimed from DEV PR.
releaseState: ISOLATED DEV source-only patch; no release/OTA performed
